title: Herbal Chilli Lamb Chops with Australian Bush Tomato Bake
description: A delicious and aromatic lamb dish that combines the flavors of the outback with a hint of herbal freshness. The Australian bush tomato adds a sweet and tangy element to this easy-to-make recipe.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together chopped oregano, thyme, garlic, and chillies.
Season the lamb chops with salt and black pepper.
Brush the lamb chops with olive oil and coat with the herbal mixture.
Place the lamb chops on a baking tray and bake for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, mix together diced Australian bush tomatoes and a pinch of salt.
Remove the lamb from the oven and top each chop with the bush tomato mixture.
Return the lamb to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.
